messages:
ashley: quick check — onboarding zeta-70b weights are staged at s3://rw-onboard/zeta-70b/v1. planning a 1M max ctx perf run but want to validate tokenizer + kv format first. anyone seen weird pad/unk behavior on converted tokenizers?

dan: i inspected the s3 objects, weights look complete. i pulled tokenizer.json and it has both "pad_token": "", and "unk_token": "<unk>" which is fine, but the converter left an extra special token in vocab. that causes length offsets when we build token->id maps.

kevin: @ashley good call. for memory sizing i recommend running a fast smoke with kv_format=kv_flat and max_seq=262144 first. kv_v2 uses slightly more memory because of per-shard metadata.

mira: fyi ran a 512k smoke earlier — CI hit OOM at step 120. gist of log:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Allocated 3.6G (GPU 0), attempted to allocate 512.0M
KV allocator: allocating 3.2G per-head -> total 51.2G
```
I hacked kv_cache.max_seq down to 262144 and it completed the step without OOM.

ci-bot: smoke-run zeta-70b-v1 started by mira at 1915001800 -> FAILED (OOM)

ashley: thanks. so two action items: 1) add tokenizer cleanup in conversion script to strip duplicate special tokens, 2) set onboarding default kv_format=kv_flat and conservative max_seq=262144 for initial runs. i'll open PR.

kevin: +1. also add a note in onboarding: if you need >262k context, run a mem-profiling job and escalate to eng-infra; don't just flip kv_v2.

mira: i'll attach the trimmed tokenizer I used in the thread and the config diff in the PR review. quick diff i used:
```
{"kv_format": "kv_flat", "kv_cache": {"max_seq": 262144}}
```
ashley: PR opened: #3456 — includes converter change, onboarding doc update, and a short script to validate tokenizer special tokens. tagging @kevin for review. :eyes:

kevin: reviewing now, will ping with small nits. :thumbsup:

ashley: great — will also run a 256k and 512k profiling job once PR lands and post results here.

ci-bot: PR #3456 created by ashley at 1915003000. CI: unit-tests passed, mem-smoke pending.
